qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/raw-evidence-index.json (all 22 artifact hashes recomputed: 16 exact, 6 hosted-run JSON match after LF normalisation)
evidence: Every instance of every/all/only/exactly-one and unchanged wording in the 3 gate, 43 Functional, 6 Polish and 3 Visual criteria was read against the public notes. WHOLE-COLLECTION instances (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml): L74 cw_block_indent_undo 'each of the two lines gains the same indent ... while the third line is not indented' (ui.md L7 'every line a selection touches'); L101 cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic 'The suffix must appear exactly once at each caret and nowhere else ... Fails if fewer than three carets receive the text', and both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click are exercised; L110 cw_multi_caret_delete 'exactly the last character of each of those two lines ... Fails if only one caret is affected, if a neighbouring line or character changes'; L119 cw_same_line_carets 'after each of the three words ... nowhere else'; L137 cw_find 'until each of the three occurrences has been the current match once', near-matches never visited; L146 cw_replace_current 'Only that middle occurrence may change; the first and last occurrences and all other text stay exact'; L155 cw_replace_all_atomic 'All four matches must be replaced and the near-match must stay unchanged ... Fails if fewer or more than the four matches change'; L164 'each of the three original occurrences must be replaced exactly once'; L173/L182 colouring 'Fails if any two of those five categories look the same' / 'any two of the four'; L254 'Fails if any of the three markers is missing'; L272 'All four markers must appear'; L290 last-good checked after error, Stop and time limit; L326 'Every probe must produce its own log line ... a probe that stays silent [is] not performed'; L335 'Each of the five must be refused' with all five words in the harmless control; L344 'the same single record with the same revision, title, filename, source and the same list of revisions'; L353 'exactly A's saved title, filename and source and exactly one new revision'; L362 'its title field, filename field and editor must still hold exactly B's unsaved values'; L371 'revisions one, two and three still listed'; L380 'exactly three revisions'; L398 title, filename, source, scroll, caret and Undo history all checked (behaviour.md L11 list). Polish judge.toml L23 'Each of these controls that the app offers and that is enabled' over an enumerated list; L41 all five focus-return actions; L50 both Undo and Redo at each of four points; L68 'any of those five areas'. UNCHANGED GUARDS THAT TOLERATE LEGITIMATE SIDE EFFECTS: L218 'console lines from the first Run may still be listed'; L326 'The app changing its own title or library for its own reasons is not a failure'; L335 'A refusal message that quotes the offending source line is not a failure' plus a payload marker built from two halves; L344 'how times or dates are displayed does not matter'; L191/L200 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure' and the HTML fixture is restricted to block-level tags with no style element so formatter whitespace cannot change rendering; L128 Undo 'repeatedly ... stop as soon as it does' tolerates per-character undo allowed by ui.md L9; L371 second-tab restore 'either refused or added on top'; L380 the ordinary Restore control 'is allowed to add a revision'; L155 Redo 'shown as disabled ... is enough'; polish L23 'a control the app has disabled because it has nothing to do is not counted'; app_context.md L24 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library', so exactly-one/duplicate checks are keyed on a unique title rather than library size. I looked for a conforming app that an unchanged guard would fail (idempotency by request key or by base-revision precondition for L380; live-library refresh and newer-revision notice during L362/L398/L407; per-character undo; formatter quote changes; app-authored status lines in the console) and found none. Scripted golden results on these bytes report all listed criteria true (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json), which is consistent but is not a configured judge run; no judge run exists for these bytes, so judge adherence to the whole-collection wording is NOT EXERCISED. NOTES (not defects): (1) L308 cw_stop_cancels_pending_work writes ONE marker 'three ways: from a timer, from an interval ... and from a Promise callback'; the negative covers all three, but the positive control only proves that at least one mechanism wrote, so an app whose preview interval or Promise callback never fires at all still passes the control. P3; using a per-mechanism suffix would close it. (2) L317 cw_newer_run_supersedes samples only a timer, while behaviour.md L7 'The same holds when a newer Run replaces an older one' covers timers, intervals and Promise callbacks; the criterion makes no 'all' claim, so this is a coverage sample, not a mis-graded plural. (3) Polish L32 'main controls have understandable visible names ... Fails if a main control has no readable name' leaves the collection 'main controls' undefined in the criterion; app_context.md L14 lists the controls, so the judge has a reference set, but the membership is not pinned. (4) Polish L41 covers 'a replacement' (ui.md L17) with Replace all only; Replace current is not sampled. (5) L74 'Shift+Tab removes that indent again' silently assumes the two-line selection survives Tab; a judge can reselect, so no conforming app is forced to fail.
